mentions.name: Replaypics
mentions.description: This app lets a person create an event album and upload photos, optionally inviting others to add their pictures. It selects the best photos and automatically makes 4 collages and 2 videos (portrait and landscape), with music chosen to match the mood of the photos and cuts synced to the beats. Albums are free to create; users pay only to get the share link.
mentions.problem: After events, photos are scattered across phones and WhatsApp, making them hard to search and retrieve, and creating memory albums in Google Photos takes effort.
